title: Restore the lr-symmetric pattern under the occluded patch

racket_target.raw_code: (rule! (lambda (g) (let ((w (cols g))) (grid-from-fn (rows g) w (lambda (r c) (if (= (cell-at g r c) 8) (cell-at g r (- (- w 1) c)) (cell-at g r c)))))))
